description: Copy file paths and line numbers for selections, functions, classes, and blocks. Customizable references for Codex, Claude Code, and Markdown notes.
setting.rangeTemplate: Template for multi-line references. See README for supported variables.
setting.singleLineTemplate: Template for single-line references. See README for supported variables.
setting.symbolTemplate: Template for symbols. lineRangeSuffix is empty for one line, otherwise -L followed by the end line.
setting.pathStyle: Path used by {path}. Workspace-relative uses the containing workspace folder, or the first compatible workspace folder for external files. Without a workspace, uses the file directory.
setting.pathStyle.option.1: Relative to the opened workspace folder, prefixed with ./ or ../
setting.pathStyle.option.2: Relative to the current file directory, prefixed with ./
setting.quickCopyBehavior: Behavior of Quick Copy Reference and the quick-copy status button.
setting.quickCopyBehavior.option.0: Copy selection exactly; with a cursor copy the smallest symbol, falling back to the current line
setting.quickCopyBehavior.option.2: Copy smallest enclosing symbol; leave clipboard unchanged if missing
setting.quickCopyBehavior.option.3: Copy smallest enclosing folding block; leave clipboard unchanged if missing
setting.showQuickCopyButton: Show the direct-copy status bar button.
setting.showOptionsButton: Show the reference-options status bar button.
setting.symbolOptionTemplate: Symbol option label. Variables: symbolIcon (Outline-style codicon in the panel), symbolName, symbolKind (name), fileName, startLine, endLine, range. Code Actions use plain text.
setting.statusBarAlignment: Side of the status bar for both buttons. Takes effect immediately.
setting.statusBarPriority: Shared placement priority for both buttons. Higher numbers move left within the chosen side. The options button uses this value minus 0.001 to keep the pair close. VS Code does not guarantee an exclusive group.
